reviews.review:
Great Tower Defense in VR that nails all the basic spots of the genre and moaaar.
First of all in VR the entire game looks like a miniature model on your floor, and you can adjust the "scale" dinamically... very fun to look while playing and you can crouch to see the units closely. Love VR visuals perspective on these games as is very comfortable to look while playing.

You have a Drone in your right hand that has some heat limitations, you place the turrets over specified platforms, you have an heroe character that follows your command on where to place it, you have separate skill tree for each tower, heroes, resources, drone and much more. Towers can evolve 4 levels and there are some bonus hidden "things" on each level, also some resistent crystals that you have to destroy "investing" tower/drone/heroe time shooting them to obtain some rewards. The skill tree gradually allows you to overcome limitations and improve each aspect, even some special powers to the heroes.

This is one of those game that I can jump in and get lost on some levels to overcome increased pressure of the waves and enemy types.

Played 4 levels (of 30) and the tutorial. All great and fun TD gameplay.
Fully recommended
reviews.developer_response: We are very glad that you enjoyed the game! Thank you very much for your review!
